derivation_disclosure: Frozen after r7.74 geometry matching increased the median pair time gap to 108s and reduced source-macro pair ordering to 0.633333. This OFAT restores the exact r7.71 nearest-time pairs and, within each training fold only, linearly removes marker area/centroid-driven change from the other 129 relation dimensions. No r7.75 result was observed; Bangkok is excluded.

geometry_residualization.fit_scope: training pair sources only inside every held-source fold
geometry_residualization.weighting: equal source mass and equal pair mass within source
geometry_residualization.transformed_geometry_channels: set to zero after residualizing semantic channels

probe.model: same symmetric signed-pair ridge without intercept as r7.71
